"""Exact QA-only eight-service rollout, no migration or paid activation.

Requires an independently accepted candidate component receipt before prepare.
Retains old config/receipt and rolls back each owned service on failed checks.
No template publication, import, policy/data approval or benchmark dispatch.
"""

import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1")
REVISION = "e49e149d814d43b8028d11cfe95e7398acbf8318"
SOURCE = "c26a7965e3ee215aa74e495c5341c15a2e0423f3952a1799111e8eef688201e4"
MANIFEST_SHA = "2825d469a78a8126e14bc71d6d592c49abb73f2c117088e8a80bc358a1936404"
OLD_CONFIG_SHA = "48ca71dac9acea4e3650452474d4c6ce23a8eece847be556b50c274dd68ec5bc"
OLD_RECEIPT_SHA = "634fc636eb4df0c5fe265457a006f42ab7900b71ad739907ac38b808b48e41a1"
CAPTURE_SHA = None
OLD_CAPTURE_SHA = "dcad1e15003676eac58cacef48f56624990b05e791de2bf21d877632b5afdfa7"
TARGET = "8e8d48c90e9aed61044241af255268156386802a1cd3713a9d6f0d3fb318b1ec"
SERVICES = ("api", "worker", "business-worker", "golden-scheduler", "golden-grader", "web",
            "native-coordinator", "private-scoring-coordinator")
OLD_IDS = {
    "api": "bad245f36a8c729f5139bf97bfc29e93adae149a034bc2c4e299af8c97e7999b",
    "business-worker": "7804ed2839f3a9593a6776a1e7334cf75ff75e3c06fceef489afb84b039109ff",
    "golden-grader": "0dc1fae1885722a31cbc4ce79249962bf195b6b7fc70538ab819f1ce3d10f4d7",
    "golden-scheduler": "169781ba1a685df1f977e7767cac763b8478711577546d79010bcfe3ca9ee11f",
    "native-coordinator": "859ec87154c9c33a40bb21104804d83895dacd6f0e839a769f6d455c0d6cc22f",
    "private-scoring-coordinator": "d6c1348434a2d6f283c6a6ad78033cb8a2808884c73c1b8936f295168830905b",
    "web": "edf9cfc2992692d67c28b420b647bde56208b56fddb5552ac8bdddca2e1dd0fb",
    "worker": "7a48d3c013c9a29ab72c3ae5d46a6dd834ddf2e0f7f24c78b3adfa4c7b3de9d5"
}
OLD_REVISIONS = {
    "api": "88214ba7b67dafe097dc297825611beb85df9637",
    "business-worker": "88214ba7b67dafe097dc297825611beb85df9637",
    "golden-grader": "88214ba7b67dafe097dc297825611beb85df9637",
    "golden-scheduler": "88214ba7b67dafe097dc297825611beb85df9637",
    "native-coordinator": "88214ba7b67dafe097dc297825611beb85df9637",
    "private-scoring-coordinator": "88214ba7b67dafe097dc297825611beb85df9637",
    "web": "88214ba7b67dafe097dc297825611beb85df9637",
    "worker": "88214ba7b67dafe097dc297825611beb85df9637"
}

FLAGS = ("ANVIL_LIVE_PROVIDERS_ENABLED", "ANVIL_HARBOR_LIVE_PROVIDERS_ENABLED",
         "ANVIL_PRAXIS_TEMPLATE_CALLS_ENABLED", "ANVIL_REAL_EMAIL_ENABLED")
INTENT_LABEL = "qualification-e49e149-v2"


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def sync_directory(path):
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        os.fsync(descriptor)
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def replace_sync(source, destination):
    os.replace(source, destination)
    sync_directory(destination.parent)


def exclusive(path, raw, mode=0o600):
    with os.fdopen(os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, mode), "wb") as stream:
        os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), mode)
        stream.write(raw)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    sync_directory(path.parent)


def image_matches(info, expected):
    metadata = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker", "image", "inspect", expected], timeout=15))[0]
    return (info["Config"]["Image"] == expected and info["Image"] == metadata["Id"]
            and expected in metadata["RepoDigests"] and metadata["Os"] == "linux" and metadata["Architecture"] == "amd64")


def comparable_host_config(value):
    """Ignore only order of literal unique binds with disjoint destinations."""
    result = copy.deepcopy(value)
    binds = result.get("Binds")
    if binds is None:
        return result
    if not isinstance(binds, list) or any(type(item) is not str for item in binds) or len(binds) != len(set(binds)):
        raise ValueError("Exact duplicate-free bind list required")
    targets = []
    for item in binds:
        parts = item.split(":")
        if len(parts) != 3 or parts[2] not in {"ro", "rw"}:
            raise ValueError("Unambiguous literal bind mode required")
        for raw in parts[:2]:
            path = Path(raw)
            if (not path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts or str(path) != raw
                    or any(character in raw for character in ("\\", "\n", "\r", "\x00"))):
                raise ValueError("Canonical literal absolute bind paths required")
        target = Path(parts[1])
        if any(target == other or target.is_relative_to(other) or other.is_relative_to(target) for other in targets):
            raise ValueError("Overlapping bind destinations cannot be normalized")
        targets.append(target)
    result["Binds"] = sorted(binds)
    return result


def owned_kind(info, name, expected_image, old_image):
    """A familiar name or revision alone can never authorize cleanup."""
    labels = info["Config"]["Labels"]
    if (info["Name"] != "/anvil-qa-v1-" + name + "-1"
            or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", info["Id"])
            or labels.get("com.docker.compose.project") != "anvil-qa-v1"
            or labels.get("com.docker.compose.service") != name):
        raise ValueError("Unknown service identity; do not stop or recreate")
    if not image_matches(info, expected_image if info["Config"]["Image"] == expected_image else old_image):
        raise ValueError("Actual immutable image ID/digest mismatch")
    if (info["Id"] == OLD_IDS[name] and info["Config"]["Image"] == old_image
            and labels.get("org.opencontainers.image.revision") == OLD_REVISIONS[name]):
        return "old"
    if (info["Id"] != OLD_IDS[name] and info["Config"]["Image"] == expected_image
            and labels.get("org.opencontainers.image.revision") == REVISION
            and labels.get("io.adi.forge.release_intent") == INTENT_LABEL):
        return "candidate"
    raise ValueError("Unknown service ownership; retain and reconcile")


def inspect(identifier):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker", "inspect", identifier], timeout=15))[0]


def schema():
    command = 'exec psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -X -A -t -c "SELECT max(version) FROM anvil.schema_versions; SELECT version_num FROM anvil.alembic_version"'
    value = subprocess.check_output(["docker", "exec", "anvil-qa-v1-postgres-1", "sh", "-c", command], timeout=15).decode().strip().splitlines()
    if value != ["133", "133"]:
        raise ValueError("Exact schema133 and Alembic133 required; never run migrate")
    return value


def quiescent():
    for folder in ("native-control-bridge", "private-grading-bridge"):
        root = ROOT / "runtime-functional" / folder
        for path in root.iterdir():
            if (path.is_dir() and (path / "request.json").exists()
                    and not any((path / name).exists() for name in ("completion.json", "failed.json", "result.json"))):
                raise ValueError("Reconcile owned bridge attempts before rollout")
    command = 'exec psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -X -A -t -c "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM banking.commands),(SELECT count(*) FROM banking.execution_jobs)"'
    if subprocess.check_output(["docker", "exec", "anvil-qa-v1-postgres-1", "sh", "-c", command], timeout=15).decode().strip() != "0|0":
        raise ValueError("Explicit reconciliation required for existing banking jobs")


def main(args):
    global CAPTURE_SHA
    CAPTURE_SHA = args.capture_receipt_sha256
    if not all(re.fullmatch("[a-f0-9]{64}", value) for value in (args.receipt_sha256, CAPTURE_SHA, args.capture_review_sha256)):
        raise ValueError("Exact independently reviewed receipt pins required")
    if os.geteuid() != 0 or os.uname().nodename != "anvil-qa-v1":
        raise ValueError("Existing QA root operator only")
    os.umask(0o077)
    config = ROOT / "config/compose-app.json"
    current = ROOT / "runtime-functional/harbor-proof/component-qualification/current.json"
    candidate = ROOT / "runtime-functional/harbor-proof/component-qualification-candidate-e49e149/current.json"
    capture = ROOT / "runtime-functional/capture-database-qualification/current.json"
    capture_candidate = ROOT / "runtime-functional/capture-database-qualification-candidate-e49e149/current.json"
    release_raw = Path("/tmp/forge-release-e49e149/release.json").read_bytes()
    if sha(release_raw) != MANIFEST_SHA or sha(config.read_bytes()) != OLD_CONFIG_SHA or sha(current.read_bytes()) != OLD_RECEIPT_SHA:
        raise ValueError("Exact current serving baseline required")
    new_receipt = candidate.read_bytes()
    release, receipt = json.loads(release_raw), json.loads(new_receipt)
    if (release["revision"] != REVISION or release["source_sha256"] != SOURCE
            or sha(new_receipt) != args.receipt_sha256 or sha(capture.read_bytes()) != OLD_CAPTURE_SHA or sha(capture_candidate.read_bytes()) != CAPTURE_SHA
            or receipt.get("qualified") is not True or receipt.get("scope") != "technical_components_only"
            or receipt.get("spending_authority") is not False or receipt.get("human_legal_rights_approval") is not False
            or receipt.get("model_performance") is not False or receipt.get("golden_source_sha256") != SOURCE
            or receipt.get("runtime_image_sha256") != release["images"]["kyc-runtime"].rsplit("sha256:", 1)[1]
            or datetime.fromisoformat(receipt["expires_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00")) <= datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            or len(receipt.get("checks", {})) != 14
            or any(item.get("status") != "passed" for item in receipt["checks"].values())):
        raise ValueError("Current exact accepted component/capture qualification required")
    controls = ROOT / "runtime-functional/controls-e49e149"
    for name in ("infra/gcp/qa_capture_database_wiring.py", "infra/gcp/qa_native_wiring.py"):
        if sha((controls / name).read_bytes()) != (release["control_files"] | release["operational_files"])[name]:
            raise ValueError("Pinned pure wiring source required")
    sys.path.insert(0, str(controls))
    from infra.gcp.qa_capture_database_wiring import PRIVATE_ENV

    old_raw, old_receipt, old_capture = config.read_bytes(), current.read_bytes(), capture.read_bytes()
    new_capture = capture_candidate.read_bytes()
    cap = json.loads(new_capture)
    if (cap["target_sha256"] != TARGET or cap["runtime_identity"]["image_sha256"] != release["images"]["backend"].rsplit("sha256:", 1)[1]
            or cap["review_receipt_sha256"] != args.capture_review_sha256
            or datetime.fromisoformat(cap["expires_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00")) <= datetime.now(timezone.utc)):
        raise ValueError("Fresh exact independently reviewed capture receipt required")
    old = json.loads(old_raw)
    new = copy.deepcopy(old)
    expected = {}
    before = {}
    for name in SERVICES:
        info = inspect(OLD_IDS[name])
        if (not info["State"]["Running"] or info["Id"] != OLD_IDS[name] or info["RestartCount"]
                or info["Config"]["Labels"]["com.docker.compose.service"] != name
                or info["Config"]["Labels"]["org.opencontainers.image.revision"] != OLD_REVISIONS[name]):
            raise ValueError("Exact actual eight-service baseline required")
        before[name] = info
        image = release["images"]["web" if name == "web" else "backend" if name in ("api", "worker", "business-worker") else "kyc-runtime"]
        expected[name] = image
        if owned_kind(info, name, image, old["services"][name]["image"]) != "old":
            raise ValueError("Actual baseline image ID/digest ownership required")
        service = new["services"][name]
        service["image"] = image
        service.setdefault("labels", {})["io.adi.forge.release_intent"] = INTENT_LABEL
        environment = service.setdefault("environment", {})
        for flag in FLAGS:
            environment[flag] = "false"
        if name != "web":
            environment["ANVIL_RUNTIME_IMAGE_DIGEST"] = release["images"]["kyc-runtime"].rsplit("sha256:", 1)[1]
    if before["api"]["HostConfig"].get("Tmpfs", {}).get("/tmp") != "rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=128m":
        raise ValueError("Accepted bounded API scratch baseline must be preserved")
    api_service = new["services"]["api"]
    if api_service.get("env_file", []).count(PRIVATE_ENV) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Exactly one existing private capture environment required")
    capture_environment = api_service["environment"]
    if (capture_environment.get("ANVIL_CAPTURE_DATABASE_TARGET_SHA256") != TARGET
            or capture_environment.get("ANVIL_CAPTURE_DATABASE_QUALIFICATION_FILE") != "/app/.data/runtime-qualification/capture-database/current.json"
            or capture_environment.get("ANVIL_CAPTURE_DATABASE_IMAGE_DIGEST") != old["services"]["api"]["image"].rsplit("sha256:", 1)[1]):
        raise ValueError("Existing capture wiring changed")
    capture_environment["ANVIL_CAPTURE_DATABASE_IMAGE_DIGEST"] = release["images"]["backend"].rsplit("sha256:", 1)[1]
    private_env = Path(PRIVATE_ENV)
    if private_env.resolve() != private_env or private_env.stat().st_uid != 0 or private_env.stat().st_mode & 0o077:
        raise ValueError("Existing private capture setting custody required")
    private_env_sha = sha(private_env.read_bytes())

    schema()
    quiescent()
    backup = ROOT / "backups/qualification-e49e149-v2"
    backup.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    sync_directory(backup.parent)
    exclusive(backup / "compose-app.json", old_raw)
    exclusive(backup / "old-component-receipt.json", old_receipt, 0o644)
    exclusive(backup / "old-capture-receipt.json", old_capture, 0o644)
    for name, info in before.items():
        exclusive(backup / ("baseline-profile-" + name + ".json"), json.dumps({"id": info["Id"],
            "image": info["Config"]["Image"], "image_id": info["Image"], "host_config": info["HostConfig"],
            "mounts": info["Mounts"], "user": info["Config"]["User"], "entrypoint": info["Config"]["Entrypoint"],
            "cmd": info["Config"]["Cmd"], "path": info["Path"], "args": info["Args"],
            "env_values_redacted": True}, sort_keys=True).encode())

    planned = backup / "compose-candidate.json"
    new_raw = json.dumps(new, sort_keys=True).encode()
    exclusive(planned, new_raw)

    active_phase = "preflight"
    mutation_unknown = False
    diagnostic_failures = []
    def run(phase, command, timeout=180):
        nonlocal active_phase, mutation_unknown
        active_phase = phase
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            mutation_unknown = phase in {"stop-old", "up-candidate"}
            for suffix, raw in (("stdout", error.stdout or b""), ("stderr", error.stderr or b"")):
                try:
                    exclusive(backup / (phase + ".partial.private." + suffix), raw)
                except BaseException as retention:
                    diagnostic_failures.append({"phase": phase, "error_type": type(retention).__name__})
            raise
        except BaseException:
            mutation_unknown = phase in {"stop-old", "up-candidate"}
            raise
        exclusive(backup / (phase + ".private.stdout"), result.stdout)
        exclusive(backup / (phase + ".private.stderr"), result.stderr)
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError("QA release command failed; private diagnostics retained")

    for key in ("backend", "web", "kyc-runtime", "marketing-runtime"):
        image_info = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker", "image", "inspect", release["images"][key]], timeout=15))[0]
        if (image_info["Config"]["Labels"]["org.opencontainers.image.revision"] != REVISION
                or release["images"][key] not in image_info["RepoDigests"]):
            raise ValueError("Actual immutable candidate image revision mismatch")
    run("compose-preflight", ["docker", "compose", "-p", "anvil-qa-v1", "-f", str(planned), "config", "--quiet"])
    schema()
    quiescent()
    if sha(config.read_bytes()) != OLD_CONFIG_SHA or sha(current.read_bytes()) != OLD_RECEIPT_SHA:
        raise ValueError("Baseline changed before release intent")
    exclusive(backup / "intent.json", json.dumps({"revision": REVISION, "old_ids": OLD_IDS,
        "old_config_sha256": OLD_CONFIG_SHA, "new_config_sha256": sha(new_raw),
        "old_receipt_sha256": OLD_RECEIPT_SHA, "new_receipt_sha256": args.receipt_sha256,
        "capture_receipt_sha256": CAPTURE_SHA, "old_capture_receipt_sha256": OLD_CAPTURE_SHA,
        "private_env_sha256": private_env_sha, "schema": 133, "migration_replayed": False}).encode())
    try:
        run("stop-old", ["docker", "stop", "--time", "10", *OLD_IDS.values()], timeout=120)
        if any(inspect(identifier)["State"]["Running"] or inspect(identifier)["State"]["Pid"] for identifier in OLD_IDS.values()):
            raise RuntimeError("Old receipt readers did not stop")
        schema()
        quiescent()
        active_phase = "preactivation-expiry-and-private-setting"
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        if (datetime.fromisoformat(receipt["expires_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00")) <= now
                or datetime.fromisoformat(cap["expires_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00")) <= now):
            raise RuntimeError("Qualification expired before activation")
        if sha(private_env.read_bytes()) != private_env_sha:
            raise RuntimeError("Private capture configuration changed before activation")
        active_phase = "activate-capture-receipt"
        temporary = capture.with_name("pending-e49e149-v2.json")
        exclusive(temporary, new_capture, 0o644)
        replace_sync(temporary, capture)
        active_phase = "activate-component-receipt"
        temporary = current.with_name("pending-e49e149.json")
        exclusive(temporary, new_receipt, 0o644)
        replace_sync(temporary, current)
        active_phase = "activate-compose"
        temporary = config.with_name("compose-e49e149-v2.json")
        exclusive(temporary, new_raw)
        replace_sync(temporary, config)
        run("up-candidate", ["docker", "compose", "-p", "anvil-qa-v1", "-f", str(config), "up", "-d",
            "--no-deps", "--force-recreate", "--no-build", *SERVICES])
        active_phase = "candidate-health"
        until = time.monotonic() + 180
        while True:
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen("https://anvil-qa.adi-labs.ai/api/v1/health", timeout=5) as response:
                    health = json.load(response)["data"]
                if (health["api"] == "ready" and health["database"] == "ready"
                        and health["live_inference"] == "disabled" and health["harbor_live_dispatch"] == "disabled"):
                    with urllib.request.urlopen("https://anvil-qa.adi-labs.ai/workspace", timeout=5) as response:
                        if response.status != 200:
                            raise ValueError("Workspace unavailable")
                    break
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
                pass
            if time.monotonic() >= until:
                raise RuntimeError("Candidate API health did not pass")
            time.sleep(2)
        observed = {}
        for name in SERVICES:
            active_phase = "profile-" + name
            info = inspect("anvil-qa-v1-" + name + "-1")
            safe_profile = {"id": info["Id"], "image": info["Config"]["Image"], "image_id": info["Image"],
                "host_config": info["HostConfig"], "mounts": info["Mounts"], "user": info["Config"]["User"],
                "entrypoint": info["Config"]["Entrypoint"], "cmd": info["Config"]["Cmd"], "path": info["Path"], "args": info["Args"],
                "state": {key: info["State"][key] for key in ("Running", "Restarting", "Pid", "ExitCode", "OOMKilled")},
                "host_differences": {key: [before[name]["HostConfig"].get(key), info["HostConfig"].get(key)]
                    for key in set(before[name]["HostConfig"]) | set(info["HostConfig"])
                    if before[name]["HostConfig"].get(key) != info["HostConfig"].get(key)},
                "env_values_redacted": True}
            safe_profile["identity_labels"] = {key: info["Config"]["Labels"].get(key) for key in
                ("com.docker.compose.project", "com.docker.compose.service", "org.opencontainers.image.revision", "io.adi.forge.release_intent")}
            exclusive(backup / ("candidate-profile-" + name + ".json"), json.dumps(safe_profile, sort_keys=True).encode())
            if owned_kind(info, name, expected[name], before[name]["Config"]["Image"]) != "candidate":
                raise RuntimeError("Exact owned candidate identity required")
            environment = dict(value.split("=", 1) for value in info["Config"]["Env"])
            if (info["Config"]["Image"] != expected[name] or not info["State"]["Running"]
                    or info["State"]["Pid"] <= 0 or info["RestartCount"]
                    or info["Config"]["Labels"]["org.opencontainers.image.revision"] != REVISION
                    or any(environment.get(flag, "false") != "false" for flag in FLAGS)):
                raise RuntimeError("Actual candidate service identity/state/OFF flags failed")
            if (info["Config"]["User"] != before[name]["Config"]["User"]
                    or info["Path"] != before[name]["Path"] or info["Args"] != before[name]["Args"]):
                raise RuntimeError("Actual runtime user/entrypoint differs from baseline")
            if comparable_host_config(info["HostConfig"]) != comparable_host_config(before[name]["HostConfig"]):
                raise RuntimeError("Full actual HostConfig differs from baseline")
            if (info["Config"]["Entrypoint"] != before[name]["Config"]["Entrypoint"]
                    or info["Config"]["Cmd"] != before[name]["Config"]["Cmd"]):
                raise RuntimeError("Ordered configured entrypoint/command differs from baseline")
            old_pairs = [item.split("=", 1) for item in before[name]["Config"]["Env"]]
            new_pairs = [item.split("=", 1) for item in info["Config"]["Env"]]
            if len(old_pairs) != len({p[0] for p in old_pairs}) or len(new_pairs) != len({p[0] for p in new_pairs}):
                raise RuntimeError("Duplicate environment keys refused")
            expected_environment = dict(old_pairs)
            expected_environment.update({key: "false" for key in FLAGS})
            if name != "web":
                expected_environment["ANVIL_RUNTIME_IMAGE_DIGEST"] = release["images"]["kyc-runtime"].rsplit("sha256:", 1)[1]
            if name == "api":
                expected_environment["ANVIL_CAPTURE_DATABASE_IMAGE_DIGEST"] = release["images"]["backend"].rsplit("sha256:", 1)[1]
            exclusive(backup / ("candidate-env-diff-" + name + ".json"), json.dumps({
                "difference_keys": sorted(key for key in set(expected_environment) | set(dict(new_pairs))
                    if expected_environment.get(key) != dict(new_pairs).get(key)),
                "expected_key_count": len(expected_environment), "actual_key_count": len(new_pairs),
                "env_values_redacted": True}, sort_keys=True).encode())
            if dict(new_pairs) != expected_environment:
                raise RuntimeError("Environment changed beyond explicit reviewed image pins/OFF flags")
            def mounts(value):
                return {item["Destination"]: (item["Type"], item["Source"], item["RW"], item.get("Propagation"), item.get("Mode")) for item in value["Mounts"]}
            expected_mounts = mounts(before[name])
            if name == "api":
                expected_mounts.update({
                    "/app/.data/capture-database-trust": ("bind", str(ROOT / "runtime-functional/capture-database-trust"), False, "rprivate", "ro"),
                    "/app/.data/runtime-qualification/capture-database": ("bind", str(ROOT / "runtime-functional/capture-database-qualification"), False, "rprivate", "ro")})
            if mounts(info) != expected_mounts or len(info["Mounts"]) != len(expected_mounts):
                raise RuntimeError("Actual role mount scope differs from exact plan")
            if name != "web":
                native = name not in ("api", "worker", "business-worker")
                python = "/opt/anvil-runtime/bin/python" if native else "/app/services/backend/.venv/bin/python"
                code = ("import json;from anvil.golden_kyc_source import source_hash;"
                        "from anvil.golden_component_qualification import installed;"
                        "assert source_hash()==" + repr(SOURCE) + ";q=installed();"
                        "assert q['ready'] is " + repr(name != "private-scoring-coordinator") + ";")
                if name == "api":
                    code += ("from anvil.marketing_capture_database_target import readiness;"
                             "c=readiness();assert c['ready'] is True and c['connection_probe_performed'] is False;"
                             "assert c['target_sha256']==" + repr(TARGET) + ";"
                             "assert c['qualification']['receipt_sha256']==" + repr(CAPTURE_SHA) + ";")
                if name == "native-coordinator":
                    code += ("from anvil.golden_native_peer import inspect_sdk;from anvil.praxis_generic_contract import digest;"
                             "s=inspect_sdk('unix:///run/docker.sock');"
                             "assert digest(s)==q['evidence']['mediated_sdk_profile_sha256'];")
                code += "print(json.dumps({'source_sha256':source_hash(),'component_ready':q['ready']}))"
                run("installed-" + name, ["docker", "exec", info["Id"], python, "-I", "-B", "-c", code], timeout=60)
            observed[name] = {"id": info["Id"], "image": info["Config"]["Image"], "restarts": info["RestartCount"]}
        active_phase = "final-receipt-config-readback"
        schema()
        if (sha(current.read_bytes()) != args.receipt_sha256 or sha(config.read_bytes()) != sha(new_raw)
                or sha(capture.read_bytes()) != CAPTURE_SHA or sha(private_env.read_bytes()) != private_env_sha):
            raise RuntimeError("Activated receipt/config changed")
        exclusive(backup / "rollout-summary.json", json.dumps({"revision": REVISION, "source_sha256": SOURCE,
            "services": observed, "schema": 133, "migration_replayed": False, "health": health,
            "component_receipt_sha256": args.receipt_sha256, "capture_receipt_sha256": CAPTURE_SHA,
            "config_sha256": sha(new_raw), "project_qualification_granted": False}).encode())
        print(json.dumps({"status": "deployed_requires_acceptance", "revision": REVISION,
            "schema": 133, "migration_replayed": False, "services": observed}))
    except BaseException as primary:
        failures, safe = [], []
        try:
            exclusive(backup / "primary-failure.json", json.dumps({"error_type": type(primary).__name__, "phase": active_phase,
                "ambiguous_mutation": mutation_unknown, "diagnostic_failures": diagnostic_failures}).encode())
        except BaseException as retention:
            failures.append({"phase": "retain-primary", "error_type": type(retention).__name__})
        for name in SERVICES:
            try:
                info = inspect("anvil-qa-v1-" + name + "-1")
                kind = owned_kind(info, name, expected[name], before[name]["Config"]["Image"])
                if kind in {"candidate", "old"}:
                    exclusive(backup / ("rollback-owned-" + name + ".json"), json.dumps({"id": info["Id"],
                        "project": "anvil-qa-v1", "service": name, "image": expected[name], "intent": INTENT_LABEL}).encode())
                    subprocess.run(["docker", "stop", "--time", "5", info["Id"]], capture_output=True, timeout=15, check=True)
                terminal = inspect(info["Id"])["State"]
                if terminal["Pid"] == 0 and not terminal["Running"] and not terminal["Restarting"]:
                    safe.append(name)
            except BaseException as error:
                failures.append({"service": name, "phase": "stop-candidate", "error_type": type(error).__name__})
        # A restored old receipt fails closed for any unconfirmed new reader.
        # Restore safe services independently rather than abandoning all API/UI
        # recovery because one coordinator could not be reconciled.
        restore_success = True
        readers_quiescent = len(safe) == len(SERVICES)
        try:
            quiescent()
        except BaseException as error:
            readers_quiescent = False
            failures.append({"phase": "rollback-quiescence", "error_type": type(error).__name__})
        for path, raw in ((current, old_receipt), (capture, old_capture), (config, old_raw)):
            try:
                temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".rollback-e49e149-v2")
                exclusive(temporary, raw, 0o600 if path == config else 0o644)
                replace_sync(temporary, path)
                if sha(path.read_bytes()) != sha(raw):
                    raise RuntimeError("Restored byte mismatch")
            except BaseException as error:
                restore_success = False
                failures.append({"phase": "restore-file", "file": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "error_type": type(error).__name__})
        if not restore_success or mutation_unknown or not readers_quiescent:
            safe = []
            failures.append({"phase": "restore-readers", "held_for_explicit_reconciliation": True})
        for name in safe:
            try:
                quiescent()
                subprocess.run(["docker", "compose", "-p", "anvil-qa-v1", "-f", str(config), "up", "-d",
                    "--no-deps", "--force-recreate", "--no-build", name], capture_output=True, timeout=120, check=True)
                restored = inspect("anvil-qa-v1-" + name + "-1")
                if (not image_matches(restored, before[name]["Config"]["Image"])
                        or restored["Config"]["Labels"].get("org.opencontainers.image.revision") != OLD_REVISIONS[name]
                        or restored["Config"]["Labels"].get("com.docker.compose.project") != "anvil-qa-v1"
                        or restored["Config"]["Labels"].get("com.docker.compose.service") != name
                        or not restored["State"]["Running"] or restored["State"]["Pid"] <= 0
                        or restored["State"]["Restarting"] or comparable_host_config(restored["HostConfig"]) != comparable_host_config(before[name]["HostConfig"])
                        or restored["Config"]["User"] != before[name]["Config"]["User"]
                        or restored["Config"]["Entrypoint"] != before[name]["Config"]["Entrypoint"]
                        or restored["Config"]["Cmd"] != before[name]["Config"]["Cmd"]
                        or restored["Path"] != before[name]["Path"] or restored["Args"] != before[name]["Args"]
                        or {item["Destination"]: (item["Type"], item["Source"], item["RW"], item.get("Propagation"), item.get("Mode")) for item in restored["Mounts"]}
                        != {item["Destination"]: (item["Type"], item["Source"], item["RW"], item.get("Propagation"), item.get("Mode")) for item in before[name]["Mounts"]}
                        or len(restored["Mounts"]) != len(before[name]["Mounts"])
                        or dict(item.split("=", 1) for item in restored["Config"]["Env"]) != dict(item.split("=", 1) for item in before[name]["Config"]["Env"])):
                    raise RuntimeError("Restored actual runtime differs from baseline")
                exclusive(backup / ("restored-" + name + ".json"), json.dumps({"id": restored["Id"], "image": restored["Config"]["Image"], "running": True,
                    "qualification_granted": False}).encode())
            except BaseException as error:
                failures.append({"service": name, "phase": "restore-old", "error_type": type(error).__name__})
        def restored_bytes(path, expected):
            try:
                return sha(path.read_bytes()) == expected
            except OSError:
                return False
        rollback_report = {"failures": failures, "safe_services": safe,
            "old_receipt_restored": restored_bytes(current, OLD_RECEIPT_SHA),
            "old_config_restored": restored_bytes(config, OLD_CONFIG_SHA),
            "old_capture_restored": restored_bytes(capture, OLD_CAPTURE_SHA),
            "restored_receipts_qualified_now": False, "migration_replayed": False}
        try:
            exclusive(backup / "rollback.json", json.dumps(rollback_report).encode())
        except BaseException as retention:
            rollback_report["report_retention_error"] = type(retention).__name__
            print(json.dumps(rollback_report), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError("Candidate failed; retained rollback evidence requires reconciliation, never replay") from None


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--receipt-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--capture-receipt-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--capture-review-sha256", required=True)
    main(parser.parse_args())
